message: You really think you're the first to trot out this worn-out routine? "Pro-life" is just a euphemism for "anti-choice" and you know it. Newsflash: just because you're too lazy to acknowledge the humanity of a developing fetus, doesn't mean the rest of us are. Your "essential for individual freedom and economic mobility" is just code for "I want to control women's bodies without being bothered with the consequences of my own actions". Save it. You're not even a good troll.

runs.justification: Calls Persona 1 a 'troll' and accuses them of being 'too lazy to acknowledge the humanity of a developing fetus'. This is a direct attack on their character and motivations, not their argument.
